name: Pars Hukuk – Yasal Hesaplama
author: ezocmpe

sections.description:
Pars Hukuk Legal Calculator is a functional module for lawyers and citizens to calculate gross-to-net fees, including VAT (20%) and Withholding Tax (20%) based on the Turkish Legal System (Serbest Meslek Makbuzu).

With its custom shortcode, it can be easily added anywhere on your site. It works completely in accordance with current Turkish tax rates.

For detailed legal consultancy and cases like Cybercrimes and Heavy Penal Court cases, you can visit our official website:
Av. Ali Alper Can – Ankara Criminal and Cybercrime Lawyer
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the [pars_hesapla] shortcode to the page where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Functional tax (VAT and Withholding) calculation algorithms added.
  • UI/UX improvements made.
